checks.plan_only: no run directory or child stage after read-only preflight
checks.execute_plan: gates pass, selected dependency runs, nonselected branch skipped; live/disk logs match
checks.failed_gate: training kept; no evaluation, dependent stage, or retry
checks.terminal_failure: exit 7 logged; no worker and no background fallback
checks.single_terminal_launch: one window command, returns during run, then train/validate/eval complete
checks.interruption_and_snapshot: SIGTERM; one of two shards retained; no final summary
checks.provenance_reuse: complete matching receipt reused; different seed rejected
checks.completed_evaluation_failed_gate: failed metric gate does not relabel a complete evaluation as partial
